scope: MED-indexed oncology trial reports; first publication date window
cursor_policy: cursorMark within each run; complete 90-day overlap on rerun catches delayed indexing and corrections
watermark_policy: advance only on successful complete fetch; truncated feeds explicitly incomplete
last_success: 2026-10-30 search cutoff; exact retrieval timestamp in acquisition_run
rate_limit: client cap 2 requests/second; not a claim of provider quota
retry: 4 attempts; 429/500/502/503/504 and transport failures; exponential backoff, Retry-After; quarantine per feed
access_limitations: Metadata and at most 24 abstract words retained; no full text. Copyright remains with owners. DOI links are not proof full text was accessed.

access_limitations: Registry updates must never be labeled new clinical outcomes
